topic: Most popular websites based on Tranco ranking

interpretations.label: Tranco composite ranking
interpretations.description: A composite website ranking derived by combining multiple ranking lists (such as Majestic, Umbrella, and Cisco OpenDNS) to reduce manipulation and noise.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Tranco combined rank position (integer, lower number indicates higher popularity/traffic)
caveats: Composite rankings rely on underlying third-party data sources which may weigh traffic or DNS queries differently.

interpretations.label: Monthly unique visitors
interpretations.description: Total distinct individuals visiting the website within a calendar month.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Count of unique IP addresses or user sessions per month (integer)
caveats: Requires third-party analytics data (e.g., Similarweb or Comscore) rather than pure DNS-based ranking.

preferredSources: Tranco Research Paper and Dataset repository (tranco-list.eu)
knownRisks: Tranco list methodology updates over time can introduce shifts in rankings unrelated to actual traffic changes.
